overview: Peelturn is a spatial routing puzzle across twelve compact boards. Launch a packet of beads and each collision deposits a permanent bead, then automatically turns the remaining packet clockwise. Because deposits and waiting packets block later travel, launch order changes the board itself.
rules: Fill every target socket and exhaust every packet.
Only a bead deposited at a stopping cell fills a socket; passing through does not count.
Every collision deposits one bead, then turns the remaining packet clockwise. Deposits become walls and waiting packets block travel.
An initially blocked launch costs nothing. A blocked clockwise exit with beads remaining, empty sockets after exhaustion, or trapped remaining packets loses the attempt.
Undo reverses an entire launch, even mid-route or after loss; retry and undo are unlimited with no timer.
controls: Tab/click selects a packet; arrows aim and preview the first stop; Space launches.
Backspace undoes a whole launch; R retries; Space/Enter advances a clear.
H shows rules; Escape pauses; K/L save/load; M sound; F fullscreen.

design.rationale:
Every impact simultaneously spends one remaining turn and builds a new steering obstacle. A seemingly wasted bead can make a later socket reachable, while filling a socket too early can obstruct another packet. You choose both launch direction and launch order, then watch your plan unfold in a crisp sequence of slides, clicks, and shrinking packets.

The closest comparison is Ricochet Robots, whose pieces slide until obstacles stop them. [Publisher description](https://www.riograndegames.com/games/ricochet-robots/). Peelturn replaces separately chosen movements with a finite automatic route: every collision consumes a bead, creates a permanent stopper, and forces a clockwise continuation. Unlike the prior Impact Orchard, deposited pieces never release stored attacks or activate each other; they change collision geometry. No supplied prior mechanic uses this rule. This comparison cannot certify worldwide originality or fun.
